verdicts.evidence: The boolean helper reads process.env[name], tests undefined and normalized values, and receives PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD at s1.
Present empty, 0, false and off strings produce false; absence falls back to configuration. The continuation tests the resulting value for falsiness rather than absence.
The helper reads the named environment variable to derive skipDownload.
The environment value feeds configuration.executablePath, which is immediately tested to set skipDownload.
The executable path is tested for truthiness with a config fallback rather than existence, and an explicit false skip-download value can override it.
The tested executable-path setting reads the process environment before falling back to configuration.

The imported lilconfig factory receives search places and its search result feeds configuration, but its implementation is absent, preventing confirmation of upward search and package.json property access.
A config executablePath or skipDownload setting can be overridden by an explicit false skip-download environment value, so reaching the continuation does not require absence of those settings.
The search result supplies application configuration used to decide browser installation.

The values merge with precedence rather than conjunction: explicit false PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD overrides skipDownload from an executable path or config, allowing continuation without all three absence conditions.
The skipDownload decision returns before browser installation jobs are created, enabling the installation path when false.
The decision permits installation according to user configuration and does not inspect analysis or sandbox signals.
Portability fits: an existing executable path defaults installation off, and application or environment configuration controls whether browsers are installed.
The early return controls the following region; its Chrome call resolves to the private downloadBrowser definition, which calls install at s6.
All three calls to the private unexported downloadBrowser helper occur after the skipDownload early return; calling the exported downloadBrowsers entry also executes that guard.
The sink binds to install imported from @puppeteer/browsers, whose implementation is absent; network and file-write operations cannot be positively established from the supplied files.
RUNNER_DEBUG controls only console.error in the import failure handler; warning and process exit occur regardless of its value.
RUNNER_DEBUG controls only console.error in the import failure handler; warning and process exit occur regardless of its value.

A false environment skipDownload overrides even a truthy configured executablePath or skipDownload (f1:111-116). An empty environment executablePath also replaces a truthy configured path before the truthiness test (f1:108-111).
The search result supplies consuming application configuration, whose executablePath and skipDownload feed the download decision (f1:87-116).

The call supplies PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD to getBooleanEnvVar, which reads process.env[name] and tests presence and lowercased value (f1:9-22). Its result supplies configuration.skipDownload tested at s2.

getBooleanEnvVar lowercases the environment value and returns false for the four listed strings (f1:14-19). That false overrides configured skipDownload and permits continuation past the early return (f1:115-116; s2).
getBooleanEnvVar reads process.env[name] with PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD supplied as the name, so env_var fits this test (f1:10; s3).

With the skip environment variable absent and the executablePath environment variable set to an empty string, that empty path replaces any configured path without setting skipDownload (f1:108-116). If configured skipDownload is absent, s2 permits continuation although c2 is false, contradicting the
The truthy skipDownload arm returns before installation jobs are created, while its other side can call downloadBrowser and install (f2:37-57; f2:14). This gate enables installation behaviour.

Continuation depends on download preferences and executable configuration, with false skipDownload allowing installation (f1:108-116; f2:37-57). These tests activate installation without checking analysis or sandbox indicators.

Portability fits: configuring an executablePath defaults installation to skipped, while explicit preferences override downloading (f1:108-116). The guarded code detects the browser platform and supplies browser, platform and cache directory to installation (f2:41-57; f2:14-22).
The region s5 follows the skipDownload early return, and its call at s7 resolves to the local downloadBrowser definition at s8. That function contains the install call at s6.

The local, unexported downloadBrowser is called only at f2:52, f2:64 and f2:76, all after the skipDownload early return. Its install call at f2:14 has no other path in the supplied files; exported downloadBrowsers still passes that guard.
